key_concepts: Soil erosion is the movement of rock fragments and soil from one place to another
Sediments are materials transported by erosion
Water, wind, animals, and humans are agents of soil erosion
Faster flowing water carries more sediments and causes quicker, farther erosion
Wind carries light soil particles and deposits them elsewhere
Burrowing animals carry soil on their bodies and break rocks with claws and hooves
Human activities such as gardening, quarrying, mining, deforestation, bad farming, and kai
Deforestation leaves soil loose and vulnerable because tree roots no longer hold water
Kaingin or slash-and-burn exposes soil to air and water, making it prone to erosion
Soil profile consists of topsoil, subsoil, and bedrock
Soil is a non-renewable resource that cannot be renewed after erosion
Quarrying and mining expose soils and can cause sediment build-up in rivers
